brief:
Israeli authorities demolished properties belonging to a Palestinian citizen of Israel who rescued 30 Israelis from the Nova music festival during the 7 October 2023 attacks, Middle East Eye reported. The demolitions targeted the homes of the individual credited with saving the festival-goers during the militant assault.

The rescuer, a Palestinian citizen of Israel, had sheltered the Israelis as gunmen attacked the outdoor event near Re'im in southern Israel. The demolitions mark a rare case in which Israeli authorities have targeted property belonging to a Palestinian credited with protecting Israeli civilians during the October 2023 violence.
dek: Israel demolishes properties of Palestinian who saved 30 Israelis on 7 October Israeli authorities have demolished properties belonging to a Palestinian citizen of Israel, who rescued 30 Israelis from the Nova music festival during the 7 October 2023 attacks.
title: Israel demolishes homes of Palestinian who rescued 30 Israelis
